structural_change: S81U-BK3 VERTICAL CUT (coordinator 0cj (b), 10-17 ~20:10): the bk clusters were ~1,160 um wide (the closed tiles' lane faces point away from the merger / control); they now stack inside the 680-um column (plan results/rtl/s81_dv_1016/bk_units_bk2/vcut_plan.json): S row 2 tiles, middle row merger-or-control + glue, N row 2 tiles (MX). Re-pinned top-down for the new neighbours; square-ish re-cut; the lane relays are gone (every hop <= ~405 um). Glue (square 172.8): rung on S / N (clock centred on S), vd on the W part of the N face (from the merger / control W of it), W face ln0 / ln2, E face ln1 / straps / ln3. The 172.8 x 259.2 trial (g2 gate 1) measured TT insertion 370.6 / spread 125.3 ps at 11% util. The S81U-BK2 kit s81dvbk_g (259.2 x 216, clock pin in the SW corner) measured TT insertion 457.3 / spread 128.2 ps. G2 ROUTE 1 (s81dvbk_g2-g2-d73a4b8db) EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION GRT-0116 (M4 248 / total 274 overflow, max 2): hotspot = the 21.6-um inter-macro channel at both macro pin faces (x 30-45 / 120-135, y 75-95: capacity 17-20 over by 1; plus cap-0 M4 pin-access gcells on the macro edges next to it): each SRAM face carries ~400 M4 pins on 41 um and the W/E lane traffic crosses through the same 11-um usable gap. Not diffuse, not PDN, not the tile pin faces. Fix: macros moved apart (y 25.92 / 105.84): inter-macro channel 21.6 -> 38.9 um, N/S channels 34.6 -> 25.9 um (>= 20).
